findings.title: before_validation crashes with NoMethodError when host is nil
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` is called unconditionally in before_validation. If the host attribute is nil (for example, POST /admin/embeddable_hosts without a `host` param, which `save_host` passes straight through), this raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a validation error. A nil guard is needed before the sub! calls.

findings.title: Stored hosts are not normalized to lowercase, so mixed-case hosts never match
findings.body: The validation regex is case-insensitive (`/i`), so `Example.com` is accepted and stored as-is. `record_for_host` compares `lower(host) = ?` against the lowercased referer/URL host, but the stored value is not lowercased. A host saved with uppercase letters therefore never matches, and embeds from that domain are rejected or import into the wrong category. Lowercase the host in before_validation, or compare with `lower(host) = lower(?)`.

findings.title: No uniqueness validation on host, so duplicate entries are allowed
findings.body: Nothing prevents the same host from being created twice. `record_for_host` uses `.first` with no ordering, so which category a host maps to becomes arbitrary when duplicates exist. The embedding admin list would also show duplicate rows. Add a uniqueness validation (case-insensitive) and ideally a unique index.

findings.title: Migration crashes when no embed_category site setting row exists
findings.body: `execute(...)[0]['id']` is called unconditionally. If the `embed_category` site setting was never changed from its default, there is no row in site_settings, so `[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError. The migration then fails and blocks the deploy. The result should be checked for emptiness before indexing, falling back to the uncategorized category.

findings.title: create_table with force: true silently drops an existing table
findings.body: If embeddable_hosts already exists (for example on a partial or re-run migration, or a table created by another branch), `force: true` drops it along with any data in it. Dropping this table is unnecessary for a fresh migration and risks data loss. Remove `force: true`.

findings.title: Host values from site settings are interpolated into SQL unescaped
findings.body: Each host from the old `embeddable_hosts` setting is spliced directly into an INSERT string. A value containing a single quote breaks the statement and makes the migration fail. Use parameterized execution or quote the value (for example with `connection.quote`).

findings.title: destroy and update crash with a 500 when the id does not exist
findings.body: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return nil. `host.destroy` in destroy (line 16) and `save_host(host)` with nil in update (line 11) then raise NoMethodError. A not-found response should be returned instead.

findings.title: Missing embeddable_host param raises NoMethodError
findings.body: `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` is accessed without checking that the `embeddable_host` key exists, so a request without it causes a 500 rather than a validation error.

findings.title: update action accepts changes but never saves anything
findings.body: `update` only re-renders the serialized embedding. Nothing is persisted, so a PUT to /admin/customize/embedding reports success while discarding its input. The client `saveChanges` action calls this endpoint and therefore appears to save while doing nothing. Either implement the save or remove the route and client call.

findings.title: saveChanges sends an empty update that does nothing
findings.body: `this.get('embedding').update({})` sends an empty payload to the server, which ignores it. This is dead or misleading code, since host changes are saved per row by the component.

findings.title: Spec only checks class inheritance; create/update/destroy are untested
findings.body: The only test asserts that the controller subclasses AdminController. The actual behavior (creating, updating, destroying hosts, the uncategorized default for blank category, and the not-found and invalid-input paths) has no test coverage.

findings.title: Embedding controller spec has no behavior tests
findings.body: The spec only checks inheritance. The show and update endpoints, and the staff-only access check, are not exercised.

findings.title: Fabricator contents are swapped between files named for the wrong content
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now contains the embeddable_host fabricator, while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb holds the category fabricators. Fabrication loads both so tests still run, but the file names mislead maintainers about where definitions live.

findings.title: Topic is created with nil category when no host record matches
findings.body: The category now comes only from EmbeddableHost. If no host record matches (for example because of the case-sensitivity issue above, or a host that was deleted), `category` becomes nil. The previous behavior of falling back to a configured category is gone, and nothing falls back to the uncategorized category.
